categories.definition: Money, a card, an account or identity was used or taken without consent, or the person was deceived into paying or sharing access.

A payment, transfer, deposit, withdrawal or cheque that failed, is delayed, went to the wrong place or has the wrong amount, with no fraud described.
Account opening, login or verification, a freeze, hold, restriction or closure, and access to the money because of it.
Fees, interest, rates, rewards or promotions, statements, balances or billing terms.
